【原视频简介】
Welcome to another drawing challenge by **Wibbydraw**!

This time, I’m drawing **HR 8799 b**, a young gas giant exoplanet located approximately **130–133 light-years from Earth**.

Watch as I draw the planet in three different time limits:

- 30 Seconds
- 3 Minutes
- 30 Minutes

HR 8799 b is one of four confirmed planets orbiting the star HR 8799. It was discovered through **direct imaging** and is estimated to have a mass around seven times that of Jupiter. The planet orbits its star at approximately 68 astronomical units and takes about 466 Earth years to complete one orbit.

Which version looks the best: the 30-second, 3-minute, or 30-minute drawing?

Subscribe to **Wibbydraw** for more drawing challenges, space art, and astronomy-inspired artwork!

**Note:** The colors, clouds, rings, and surrounding objects in this artwork are artistic interpretations and are not confirmed features of HR 8799 b.
